summary: Offers observations on simple best-effort traffic, loosely defined as Internet traffic not covered by quality-of-service mechanisms, congestion-based pricing, cost-based fairness, or admission control. It argues that best-effort traffic plays a useful role in the Internet and is worth keeping, and discusses how it relates to differentiated treatment.

eli5.summary: Best-effort is like a public road open to all, with no reserved lanes. This paper says that is a good thing worth keeping, even if some drivers also get special lanes.
